caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic pitcher with a blue body and white decorative elements. The pitcher has a rounded shape with a pronounced spout and a curved handle. The upper rim, handle, base, and ornamental relief of the pitcher are all rendered in a pale, almost white color. The midsection of the pitcher displays a detailed leafy plant motif in white, with stems, leaves, and flower buds rising from the base and encircling the sides. A row of white, textured leaves also encircles the upper part of the vessel just below the rim. The background is a plain beige color, and the pitcher is shown resting on a flat, wood-textured surface. Above the pitcher, text reads "PARIAN PITCHER EARLY 19th CENTURY" and "POTTER'S MARK." Between the lines of text, there is a small illustration of a ceramic mark labeled "JSP 17 14."
title: Parian Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
